---
name: Feature request / idea
about: Suggest an enhancement
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

> **Before filing this:** please skim the docs to confirm the tool doesn't
> already support what you need. Many requests turn out to be features
> that already exist under a different menu item or workflow.
>
> - [Setup](../docs/setup.md)
> - [Sending Campaigns](../docs/sending-campaigns.md)
> - [Managing Subscribers](../docs/managing-subscribers.md)
> - [Partitions and Gmail Quotas](../docs/partitions-and-quotas.md)
> - [Configuration](../docs/configuration.md)
>
> If you're not sure whether your idea is already possible, please ask in
> [Discussions → Q&A](../../discussions) first instead of opening this issue.

## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool doesn't currently support?

## What I've tried in the current tool

Which existing Admin Tools menu items did you try, and what didn't work
about them? (e.g. "I used Partition filter + Schedule Re-Send but it sent
to everyone, not just the partition.")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like the tool to do, and roughly how you imagine it working
in the Admin Tools menu or sidebar.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've thought about solving it (workarounds, manual steps,
other tools).

## Who benefits

Is this useful only to you, or do you think other users would want it?
